items.title: Bitter with Australia for deporting him, he hatched a plan to get even
items.description: Eneasi Taumoefolau's 2024 arrest on drugs charges ignited fears the notoriously violent outlaw Comancheros gang had infiltrated "the Friendly Islands".

items.title: Why the gas giants stopped gouging
items.description: After a decade and a half of mostly failed threats from three prime ministers and constant surveillance by the competition regulator, the east coast gas export giants are suddenly putting Australians first.

items.title: Live: Woolworths fronts Federal Court on dodgy discount allegations
items.description: Supermarket giant Woolworths faces off with the consumer watchdog in court. The ASX 200 rose at the open but has since dipped into the red. Follow the day's events on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Did you really get a discount on your Tim Tams? The ACCC doesn't think so
items.description: The sequel to Australia's supermarket pricing wars is about to kick off in the Federal Court as the ACCC takes on Woolworths over what it argues are misleading pricing practices.

items.title: Live: Trump 'unlikely' to extend ceasefire deadline as Iranian negotiator says nation won't accept peace talks
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is unlikely to extend a ceasefire, set to expire on Wednesday night, US time.

items.title: What to know about new CEO of one of world's biggest tech companies
items.description: The new CEO of Apple will be tasked with catching up in the AI race and continuing the company's legacy as a dominating force in the technology world.

items.title: Breaking: New Zealand prime minister survives confidence vote
items.description: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon says he has the support of his party after calling and winning a vote of confidence in his leadership.

items.title: Residents urged to evacuate New Zealand's capital after floods
items.description: People living in low-lying areas of New Zealand's capital city, Wellington, have been urged to evacuate, as heavy rain continued to drench the city.

items.title: Dezi Freeman's shipping container entered by YouTubers, police investigate
items.description: YouTubers are being investigated for trespass after filming inside the converted shipping container where fugitive gunman Dezi Freeman hid after shooting dead two police officers.

items.title: Controversial rapper's bodyguard allegedly assaulted in Sydney abduction
items.description: Five men have been arrested after police rescued a controversial rapper's bodyguard who was allegedly kidnapped from his Guildford home.

items.title: More women like Celine are being diagnosed with ADHD. We're not sure why
items.description: Within the sharp increase of ADHD rates in Australia lies a hidden story — more women are being prescribed medication than men. Understanding why is more complicated.

items.title: Live: PM to convene national cabinet to tackle 'long tail' fuel crisis
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has revealed he will be convening national cabinet again in the coming days. Follow live.

items.title: NRL overhauls training rules in landmark player safety move
items.description: The move to restrict training loads is aimed at mitigating injuries, including player head injuries, which continue to be a major issue for all contact sports.

items.title: Living in an apartment with your dog? Here are four things to consider
items.description: Providing opportunities for your dog to explore, giving them a safe and comfortable space to retreat to — as well as a good routine — are key to keeping your dog happy.

items.title: Six ways your smartwatch is lying to you, according to science
items.description: Wearable fitness technologies like smartwatches are worn by millions of people daily. But they're not as accurate as you might think.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: F1 makes 'sensible changes' after engine concerns to start season
items.description: The next Formula 1 race in Miami will be a testing and proving ground for a number of new rules aimed at improving performance and safety.

items.title: US officials press Cuba for reforms in 'respectful' meeting in Havana
items.description: Cuba says the exchange was conducted "respectfully and professionally" and that the US delegation did not issue any threats or deadlines.

items.title: King Charles pays tribute to 'darling Mama' on late queen's 100th birthday
items.description: The king's moving homage comes as the final master plan for the memorial for the nation's longest-serving monarch is unveiled.

items.title: Homes damaged, roof ripped off as possible tornado strikes WA's South West
items.description: Winds of more than 100 kilometres an hour swept through the South West of WA last night, with damage reported in a suburb of East Bunbury.

items.title: Where does all the NDIS money go and how did we get here?
items.description: With more changes surrounding the NDIS set to be announced, here’s everything you need to know about the scheme.

items.title: One dead and six injured after shooting at Mexico's Teotihuacán pyramids
items.description: A Canadian tourist has died and at least six other people have been injured after a man opened fire while atop of one of the historic Teotihuacán pyramids in Mexico.

items.title: SA childcare centre forced to close over seven supervision incidents
items.description: Another Adelaide childcare centre has been forced to shut its doors for three months after seven incidents of children being left unsupervised.

items.title: Group that helped find Celine Cremer plan their next missing person search
items.description: After helping find missing tourist Celine Cremer, some of the search volunteers plan to formalise their group and take on other missing persons cases, including that of a man who went missing last year.

items.title: Japan warns of increased risk of mega-quake after 7.7-magnitude one
items.description: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 7.7 struck off the north-eastern coast of Japan, triggering tsunami warnings and widespread evacuation orders affecting about 170,000 people.
